cases.description: User constraints, exact ingredient quantities, proposal tasks and source references are explicit.
Unknown household quantity is retained as unknown with a planning-blocker uncertainty.
Unknown ingredient quantity without a matching uncertainty record is rejected.
A quantity marked mass but expressed in litres is rejected.
An absent local lot reference remains absent; supplier listing does not create household inventory.
Task and ingredient references must resolve inside the proposal.
Task dependency cycles are rejected before downstream compilation.
A fact validity end before observation time is rejected; current freshness remains an as-of evaluation.
A budget amount requires a three-letter uppercase currency code.
No appliance/module assignment, device resource ID, actuator or command field exists in this proposal contract.
